reports.actual: The page displays "3 items | Items 3 items".

steps: Add Ethiopia Guji to cart twice.

reports.title: Checkout fails with server error and no confirmation message
steps: Fill in Full name, Email address, Street address, and City.
Observe that no "Thank you!" or confirmation text appears.
reports.expected: Order submission should succeed and display a thank‑you/confirmation message.
reports.actual: POST /checkout returned a 500 error, and the page shows no "Thank you!" or "is confirmed" text.
